requirements.text: Shipped full-stack products before—whether in your day job or projects outside of work.
Experience working in low-structure environments, comfortable working with unknowns.
Passion for building engineering tools, excited about solving problems for engineers.
Strong communication skills. You can explain a subtle failure mode to a staff engineer and its business impact to a VP in the same meeting.
Genuine interest in the customer-facing half of this. You don't have to have done it before, but you should want to—being in the room energizes you rather than draining you.
Willingness to travel occasionally to customer sites.
An ideal candidate has a unique mix of software expertise, system design, and proficiency in HCI—plus the willingness to sit in a customer's office and debug their build system.
